content: permit(principal in OpensearchMCP::Role::"opensearch-reader", action in [OpensearchMCP::Action::"ListIndexTool", OpensearchMCP::Action::"IndexMappingTool", OpensearchMCP::Action::"SearchIndexTool", OpensearchMCP::Action::"GetShardsTool", OpensearchMCP::Action::"ClusterHealthTool", OpensearchMCP::Action::"CountTool", OpensearchMCP::Action::"MsearchTool", OpensearchMCP::Action::"ExplainTool"], resource);
permit(principal in OpensearchMCP::Role::"opensearch-writer", action in [OpensearchMCP::Action::"GenericOpenSearchApiTool"], resource);
forbid(principal, action == OpensearchMCP::Action::"DestructiveOperation", resource) unless { principal in OpensearchMCP::Role::"opensearch-admin" };
